# `arch/arm/include/arch_impl/user_layout.h`

ARMv7-A user address-space layout.

```c
#include <arch_impl/user_layout.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="user_va_top"></a>`USER_VA_TOP` | `0x80000000UL` | End of user space; TTBR0 maps everything below (TTBCR.N = 1). |
| <a id="user_syspage_va"></a>`USER_SYSPAGE_VA` | `0x00001000UL` | Where the syspage is mapped in every space. |
| <a id="user_bootinfo_va"></a>`USER_BOOTINFO_VA` | `0x00002000UL` | Where the boot information pages are mapped in the root service. |
| <a id="user_elf_base"></a>`USER_ELF_BASE` | `0x00010000UL` | Lowest address program segments are loaded at. |
| <a id="user_mmap_base"></a>`USER_MMAP_BASE` | `0x20000000UL` | Start of the area for mappings without a fixed address. |
| <a id="user_device_base"></a>`USER_DEVICE_BASE` | `0x7F000000UL` | Start of the device-mapping window; end of the general mapping area. |
| <a id="user_device_limit"></a>`USER_DEVICE_LIMIT` | `0x7F7FE000UL` | End of the device-mapping window. |
| <a id="user_stack_guard_va"></a>`USER_STACK_GUARD_VA` | `0x7F7FF000UL` | Unmapped guard page below the stack reserve. |
| <a id="user_stack_base"></a>`USER_STACK_BASE` | `0x7F800000UL` | Bottom of the 8 MiB stack reserve, faulted in on demand. |
| <a id="user_stack_top"></a>`USER_STACK_TOP` | `0x80000000UL` | Top of the stack reserve. |
| <a id="usr_sp"></a>`USR_SP` | `0x7FFFE000UL` | Initial stack pointer of a new program; argv is laid out just below it. |
